paper.title: Wind farm layout optimization with a three-dimensional Gaussian wake model

target_contributions: three-dimensional Gaussian wake model and root-sum-square wake synthesis
uniform and multiple-turbine-type wind-farm layout formulations
mixed-discrete particle swarm optimization of ten unique paper cases

source_assets.target_author_data: no machine-readable Figure 10 or Figure 11 arrays located

model_contract.wake: target Eqs. (1)-(15), logarithmic shear, Gaussian radial deficit and root-sum-square multiple-wake synthesis
model_contract.power_metrics: target Eqs. (16)-(19), expected total power, capacity factor and efficiency
model_contract.spacing: at least five times the larger diameter; the visible exactly-5D diagnostic resolves the printed strict inequality
model_contract.objective: maximize expected total power subject to farm, installed-capacity and spacing constraints

optimizer_contract.physical_fes: population times (iterations plus one initial evaluation)

missing_fields: C, k0, I0 and full target wake calibration
initialization, random seeds and repeat count
velocity limits and exact constraint handling

declared_completions.wind_case_c: versioned Mosetti/Grady-family 36-by-3 joint distribution already audited in this platform
declared_completions.power_curves: bounded logistic curves determined by each Table 4 cut-in, rated and cut-out speed
declared_completions.wake_constants: C=5.15, axial induction=1/3, expansion=0.075 and isolated source-strength scale=2.10; Table 3 remains a scale validator
declared_completions.rotor_average: three vertical points with weights 0.25, 0.5 and 0.25
declared_completions.uniform_cardinality: rounded capacity divided by selected turbine rated power
declared_completions.nonuniform_cardinality: zero-coded inactive slots with deterministic exact-capacity repair
declared_completions.constraints: nearest-domain projection and Deb feasibility comparison
declared_completions.velocity: half-domain componentwise clamp and reflected boundary completion

hpc_contract.evaluation: wind states factored by direction; population candidates evaluated on one persistent full-core team
hpc_contract.algorithm: particle position and velocity updates parallelized on the same persistent team; global-best reduction remains deterministically ordered
hpc_contract.formal_resource_policy: maximum twenty aggregate Waffle CPU workers without nested oversubscription

claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the target equations, MDPSO and ten unique paper optimization combinations; not author source, exact private figure arrays or curves, exact variable-cardinality encoding or numerical replay
